citations.quote: The Brinson and Fachler model solves this problem by modifying the asset allocation factor

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Brinson-Fachler refines BHB allocation to (wi-Wi)(bi-b), so an overweight adds value only when the sector beats the OVERALL benchmark, not merely when its return is positive; the redefinition sums to zero across sectors.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Brinson-Fachler: Benchmark-Relative Allocation
